machine: Transformers: More Than Meets the Eye (Stern Pinball, 2026)

shots.name: Left Orbit
shots.notes: Grimlock/Dinobot orbit; runs up the left and feeds the upper-right flipper. Gated by two Grimlock standups that light Dinobot missions.

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: Far-right orbit, mirror of the center spinner path; shootable from the left flipper. Starscream Frenzy collect.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: Autobot reverse-scoop ramp, fast return to the left flipper. Target of the Megatron cannon fire on Prem/LE.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: Steepest shot; feeds the lower-right flipper or loads the Megatron cannon. One Shall Fall qualifier; Countdown to Extinction save.

shots.name: Side Ramp
shots.notes: Hardest ramp, above Megatron; collects Combiner parts; super jackpot in multiball. Reached from the upper-right flipper. Frequent drain risk on reject.

shots.name: Center Spinner
shots.notes: Dead-center spinner; fills the Energon cube; a right-flipper shot through it feeds the upper flipper.

shots.name: Center VUK
shots.notes: Vertical up-kicker / lock hole for Transformers Multiball; default bailout kicks to the right flipper. Pro diverts to upper flipper; Prem/LE feeds the animatronic cannon.

shots.name: Megatron Scoop
shots.notes: Mission start and final blow, behind the 3-bank drop targets.

shots.name: 3-Bank Drop Targets
shots.notes: Three drops with a center gap post, blocking the Megatron scoop; knock down to start missions and qualify hurry-ups.

shots.name: Bumblebee Captive Ball
shots.notes: Spells BUMBLEBEE for Playfield X (2x); changes color with hits; relit via pop bumpers.

shots.name: Optimus Prime (bash toy)
shots.notes: Autobot-side bash toy at top-left; raises jackpot/ramp values, relights Transformers lock, and resets mission timer. Best handled with the right flipper.

shots.name: Space Bridge
shots.notes: Upper-right late shot from the upper flipper; skill shot, mystery award, add-a-ball, extra ball, Combiner MB start and super.

shots.name: Cassette Target
shots.notes: Soundwave target; lit by left-inlane roll for Cassette combos; starts Soundwave modes (hit 3x).

shots.name: Grimlock Standups (x2)
shots.notes: Two standups flanking the left-orbit mouth; hit both to gate/qualify Dinobot missions.

shots.name: Spinner Standup
shots.notes: Color-coded Tech Spec standup near the center spinner.

shots.name: Right-Ramp Standup
shots.notes: Color-coded Tech Spec standup near the right ramp.

shots.name: Side-Ramp Standup
shots.notes: Color-coded Tech Spec standup near the side ramp (upper right).

shots.name: Megatron Scoop Standups (cyan, x2)
shots.notes: Two cyan standups flanking the Megatron scoop (x≈0.46 and 0.60); used in the Solar Needle mission to light the captive ball.

shots.name: Pop Bumper(s)
shots.notes: Upper-right jet bumpers; hits light Mystery (at space bridge) and relight the Bumblebee captive ball, and advance Playfield X.

shots.name: Upper-Left Slingshot
shots.notes: Hidden slingshot near Grimlock; changes which Dinobot mission is selected; unpredictable kick-outs raise drain risk.

shots.name: Megatron Fusion Cannon
shots.notes: Animatronic cannon: rotating top, raising arm, fires the locked ball across the playfield toward the left ramp. Pro substitutes a static ball-divert to the upper flipper.

shots.name: Soundwave (cassette deck)
shots.notes: Physical cassette-deck ball lock and launcher; Pro uses the cassette standup + virtual locks instead.

shots.name: Grimlock (Dinobot) sculpt
shots.notes: Static Grimlock sculpt (Prem/LE cosmetic). Dinobot missions play on all editions via the Grimlock standups.

shots.name: Plunger / Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Standard plunger; soft-plunge feeds the upper-right flipper for the skill shot.

shots.name: Upper-Right Flipper
shots.notes: Third flipper mid-playfield right; fed by left orbit and plunge; shoots side ramp, space bridge, and upper-right shots.

shots.name: Left (lower) Flipper
shots.notes: Standard lower-left flipper.

shots.name: Right (lower) Flipper
shots.notes: Standard lower-right flipper; used to catch the ball for the secret skill shot.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Tug-of-war qualifier: roll 2x without the right inlane to light Autobot Hurry-Up; also lights the Cassette target.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Roll 2x without the left inlane to light Starscream Frenzy at the right orbit.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Auto ball save lit at game start; relight only via Mystery. Preserve for late game.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: On the last ball, draining here starts Countdown to Extinction (~15-18s to shoot the right ramp to save).

shots.name: Left Slingshot
shots.notes: Standard slingshot above the left inlane; randomly lit in Dinobot War.

shots.name: Right Slingshot
shots.notes: Standard slingshot above the right inlane; randomly lit in Dinobot War.

goals.title: Optimus Skill Shot
goals.summary: The safest of the three standard skill shots: short-plunge to the upper flipper and hit Optimus Prime for a quick, reliable ball-save extension.

steps.detail: A short plunge feeds the ball to the upper-right flipper untouched.

steps.action: Hit Optimus off the upper flipper

goals.title: Side Ramp Skill Shot

steps.detail: A short plunge feeds the ball to the upper-right flipper untouched.

steps.action: Thread the Side Ramp off the upper flipper
steps.detail: The machine's steepest, most reject-prone ramp — worth more than Optimus but riskier to make clean.

goals.title: Space Bridge Skill Shot
goals.summary: The best-paying standard skill shot: short-plunge to the upper flipper and hit Space Bridge for the top standard value and the longest ball-save extension.

steps.detail: A short plunge feeds the ball to the upper-right flipper untouched — the same launch as the Optimus and Side Ramp skill shots.

steps.action: Shoot Space Bridge off the upper flipper
steps.detail: Highest-value of the three standard upper-flipper shots: 8M and a +10s ball-save extension.

goals.title: Secret Skill Shot
goals.summary: Highest-value opener: short-plunge but outrun the feed to catch on the lower-right flipper, shoot the Left Orbit past Grimlock to reach the upper flipper, then complete any of the three upper-flipper skill shots for a premium payout.
goals.reward: 15M + 10s ball save at Space Bridge (Optimus/Side Ramp pay more than standard here too, but their secret-route values aren't published)

steps.detail: Release early instead of letting the ball settle onto the upper flipper — the same short-plunge strength as the standard skill shot, just caught differently.
Cradle the ball on the lower-right flipper instead of riding it up to the upper flipper.

steps.action: Shoot the Left Orbit past Grimlock
steps.detail: Released from the cradle, the orbit past the Grimlock standups feeds back up to the upper-right flipper.

Optimus, Side Ramp, and Space Bridge are all live from here. Space Bridge pays the most at 15M + 10s; the other two are confirmed to exist but their secret-route values aren't published anywhere we could find.

goals.title: Energon and Cosmic Rust: Set Your Own Difficulty
goals.summary: There are five missions and you decide the terms of each one before it starts. Spinner rips bank energon cubes; spending a cube makes the next mission easier and cheaper, while saving it lets you rust the mission after that into something much harder and much better paid. What changes is the actual objective, not just the payout.
instructions: Use the flippers before starting to choose which of the five missions comes next
Missions start at Megatron's scoop — one shot there for the first two of a game, more for later ones
Rip the centre spinner to bank energon cubes
Spend a cube and the next mission runs energized, with easier requirements and a lower payout
Keep the cube, clear a mission at normal grade, and you can rust the following one: much harder, much bigger
Grade changes the objective itself — Golden Lagoon asks 10M from the spinner energized, 25M normal, 60M rusted
After a mission's shots are done, Megatron is there for the final blow, but the mission completes with or without it
goals.reward: Control over both the difficulty and the point value of every mission you start

goals.title: Tech Specs: The Five Colours Everything Else Runs On
goals.summary: Almost every other system on this machine is paid for in tech specs. Standup targets sitting between the major shots light those shots for a spec in the target's colour, and what you bank buys an extra ball, a multiball, combiner parts, and the only conditions under which your mission shot multipliers are worth anything.
instructions: Hit a standup to light a nearby major shot for a tech spec in that target's colour
Five colours are in circulation across the playfield
Fifteen tech specs in total, in any mix of colours, lights the extra ball at the space bridge
Three of every colour starts Tech Spec Mania, a three-ball multiball
Specs banked in one colour also pay out as combiner parts
A mission's final blow puts a 2x multiplier on a shot — but it only pays while a tech spec is lit there, so neither system is worth much without the other
goals.reward: Extra ball, Tech Spec Mania three-ball multiball, combiner parts, and live mission shot multipliers

goals.title: Build Combiners, Then Spin for Your Jackpot
goals.summary: Five combiners at five parts each, collected one at a time mostly off the side ramp. Three completed combiners open the multiball, and once inside it a spinning grid picks which combiner actually pays — so every one you left half-built is a slot that grid can land on and waste.
instructions: Five combiners, five parts each
The side ramp supplies most parts; banking a single colour of tech specs awards them too
Three completed combiners light the space bridge for Combiner Multiball
Hit the action button instead of starting it to defer the multiball and relight it after your next combiner finishes
Once running, shoot the spinner or hold the action button to spin the combiner grid — you want it landing on one you actually finished, which is what lights jackpots at the major shots
Jackpots start at 8M with three combiners and reach 10M with all five, so finishing extras pays directly
Two jackpots light the side ramp and space bridge for a super jackpot, which adds a ball scaled to how many combiners you completed before spinning the grid again
goals.reward: Combiner Multiball with jackpots based at 8M for three combiners, rising to 10M with all five

goals.title: Spell BUMBLEBEE, Then Take It to 3x
goals.summary: The playfield multiplier comes off the captive ball three letters at a time and pays thirty seconds of doubled scoring. There is a route to triple inside a multiball, but the 2x has to already be running when that multiball begins.
instructions: Each hit on a lit captive ball adds three letters to BUMBLEBEE
Three lit hits complete it and arm the captive ball for thirty seconds of 2x
If the captive ball has gone dark, two bumper hits relight it; if the bumper is dark too, a mystery award is your way back
Start the 2x before the multiball, not during — it must be live going in
In multiball the space bridge adds a ball and holds it, and there is only one add-a-ball per game
Shoot that held ball to step 2x up to 3x with a fresh thirty seconds
goals.reward: Thirty seconds of 2x scoring, upgradeable to 3x inside a multiball

goals.title: Bank Energon and Stack Perks Before One Shall Fall
goals.summary: The Optimus Prime and Megatron duel lights early and then simply waits for you. What it pays, and how survivable it is, depends on the energon you are still holding, how many missions you rusted, how many final blows you landed, and how many missions you played at all before cashing it in.
instructions: Two missions light the right ramp for One Shall Fall
There is no obligation to start it — leaving it lit while you play more missions makes it both richer and easier
The final blow value is built from banked energon, rusted missions taken on, and final blows landed during missions
Each mission played beforehand grants a perk that alters the duel's shot rules, thinning the red shots or making Megatron easier to damage
Damage Megatron on the purple shots, avoid the red ones, then finish at his scoop
Clear all five missions instead and the VUK lights for the other mini-wizard, Rescue Optimus
goals.reward: A mini-wizard duel whose value and difficulty you set for yourself in advance

drills.title: Upper Flipper Skill Ladder
drills.text: Short-plunge to the upper flipper and work all three skill targets in turn: Optimus, side ramp, space bridge. The payout ladder runs in the same order as the difficulty, so find out where that flipper actually points before you commit to the top of it.

drills.title: Outrun The Plunge
drills.text: Same short plunge, but release early and catch the ball on the lower right flipper instead of letting it settle upstairs. From that cradle the left orbit past Grimlock carries it back to the upper flipper with every skill target still live.

drills.title: Side Ramp Reps
drills.text: Feed the upper-right flipper off the left orbit and take the side ramp over and over. It is the hardest ramp on the machine, combiner parts come off it, and a reject is a real drain risk, so nudge up on the miss instead of watching it come back.

drills.title: Autobot Run String
drills.text: Run the fixed order until it is muscle memory: center spinner, left ramp, right orbit, left orbit, side ramp. It is the same five shots every time, so the only variable left is whether you hesitate between them.

drills.title: Cassette Three-Way
drills.text: Roll the left inlane to light the Cassette target, then chain right ramp into left ramp into the target before the light dies. Land the full three-way and the button is loaded with a Tech Spec window you can spend where it counts.

drills.title: The Save Shot, Cold
drills.text: Take the right ramp from a settled cradle, then again off a live inlane feed. On the last ball a right-outlane drain gives you one short window and this one shot, and it is the steepest shot on the machine to be attempting cold.

actionButton.label: Action Button
actionButton.how: Two very different jobs. It cashes the reward you earn from cassette combos, and inside Combiner Multiball it is the steering wheel that decides which Combiner your jackpots come from.

uses.when: After any cassette combo (Cassette target off a lit left inlane)
uses.what: The button lights; press it to turn on every Tech Spec for 15 seconds and double scoring at completed mission shots.
Press to shelve it — the multiball requalifies when your next Combiner finishes, so you can stack it better.
Hold it to cycle the Combiner grid; land on one you completed and jackpots light at the upper flipper shots, spinner, Megatron and right ramp.

uses.when: While holding the button in that multiball
uses.what: White build shots keep raising the jackpot value as the grid cycles.
Use it again to pick the next Combiner and restart the jackpot wave.

howItPlays.objective: Transformers puts the Autobot and Decepticon war under glass: run Megatron's five missions, assemble Combiners, and bring Optimus and Megatron to a head-to-head duel. Set each mission's difficulty with Energon, stack playfield multipliers into Transformers Multiball, and reach the mini-wizards One Shall Fall and Rescue Optimus.
loop: Knock down the three Megatron drop targets to open the scoop, scroll to a mission with the flippers, and start it -- spend or bank an Energon cube first to set that mission's difficulty and payout.
Rip the center spinner to bank Energon cubes, and hit the color-coded standups to light nearby shots for the Tech Specs that feed the extra ball, Combiners, and your mission shot multipliers.
Feed the center VUK to lock balls for Transformers Multiball, and spell BUMBLEBEE at the captive ball to arm 2x playfield before you start it.
Play two missions to light One Shall Fall at the Right Ramp; clear all five instead and the VUK opens for Rescue Optimus, handing you an extra ball too.

lights.name: Megatron Drops & Mission Scoop
lights.lit: The three drop targets sit lit in front of the Megatron scoop and block it; knocking them down opens the scoop, and they reset as the recurring toll on every new mission.
lights.flashing: The scoop flashes when a mission is ready to start or a mission's final blow is lit.

control.effect: with the scoop open, the flippers scroll the five missions so you start the one whose shots you are hitting cleanly, and spending or banking an Energon cube beforehand sets whether it runs Energized (easier, smaller) or Rusted (harder, far bigger)
control.when: drops cleared, scoop lit, no mission running

lights.then: Start your pick at the scoop, make its shots, then cash the final blow back at the scoop for a 2x shot multiplier; clearing all five missions lights the VUK for Rescue Optimus and an extra ball at the Space Bridge.

lights.name: BUMBLEBEE Playfield X
lights.lit: The Bumblebee captive ball adds three BUMBLEBEE letters per lit hit and changes color as it climbs; if it has gone dark, two pop-bumper hits relight it.
lights.then: Three lit hits complete the word and arm thirty seconds of 2x playfield -- start it just before a multiball, then shoot the Space Bridge for its once-a-game add-a-ball and bash the captive ball again within ten seconds to push the whole thing to 3x.

lights.name: Tech Spec Standups
lights.lit: Hitting a color-coded standup lights the major shot beside it for a Tech Spec in that target's color, and the specs you bank hold as a running inventory across five circulating colors.
lights.then: Collect fifteen specs in any mix to light the extra ball at the Space Bridge, three of every color to start Tech Spec Mania, and keep in mind a mission's final-blow 2x only pays while a spec is lit on that shot -- so neither system scores much without the other.

lights.name: Transformers Multiball Locks
lights.lit: The center VUK lights for a lock after its shots stack up, and each locked ball holds -- physically on Premium and LE, virtually on Pro -- until three are banked.
lights.flashing: Major shots flash as they cycle purple to red to a flashing jackpot during the multiball.
lights.then: Lock three to start Transformers Multiball, hit a major shot until it turns over for each jackpot, and cash the Super Jackpot at the Side Ramp for the combined base value of every jackpot you banked.

lights.name: Combiner Parts & Grid
lights.lit: Each Combiner needs five parts, most coming off the Side Ramp, and a completed Combiner stays built for the rest of the game.
lights.flashing: The Space Bridge flashes for Combiner Multiball once three of the five Combiners are built.

control.effect: inside Combiner Multiball, holding the button spins the Combiner grid -- land it on one you actually finished and jackpots light at the upper-flipper shots, the spinner, Megatron and the Right Ramp, while a half-built Combiner is just a slot the grid can waste itself on

lights.then: Build three Combiners to start at the Space Bridge, spin the grid onto a finished one for eight-to-ten-million jackpots, then finish the Side Ramp into the Space Bridge for a super that tacks on an extra ball, sized to the number of Combiners you had built going in.

lights.name: Cassette Combo & Button
lights.lit: Rolling the Left Inlane briefly lights the Cassette target, and chaining the Right Ramp into the Left Ramp into that lit target completes the three-way Cassette combo before the light dies.

control.effect: completing a Cassette combo lights the button -- press it to switch on every Tech Spec for fifteen seconds and double scoring at your completed mission shots
control.when: right after a Cassette three-way combo

lights.then: Complete the combo, press the lit button, then cash the fifteen-second window at shots carrying a mission final-blow 2x -- the game's go-to repeatable scoring loop.

lights.name: Inlane Tug-of-War
lights.lit: Once the Megatron drops are cleared the return lanes light a tug-of-war, and you pick a side by which lane you feed the ball through rather than by tapping a flipper.
lights.then: Roll the Left Inlane twice without touching the right and the Left Ramp lights for a chain of pink hurry-up shots opening at fifteen million; feed the Right Inlane twice while sparing the left instead, and Starscream Frenzy lights over at the Right Orbit.

lights.name: Grimlock & Dinobot Missions
lights.lit: The two Grimlock standups flanking the Left Orbit gate the Dinobot missions, and hitting both lights the orbit's orange arrow to start one.
lights.then: Shoot the lit Left Orbit on its orange arrow to start the selected Dino mission -- the hidden upper-left slingshot quietly cycles which one -- then score three Dino Jackpots back at the Left Orbit to complete it and qualify Dinobot Desertion.

scoring.text: Short-plunge to the upper flipper and take a skill shot -- Space Bridge pays the most of the standard three at eight million with a ten-second ball save, the back-door secret route fifteen. Clear the Megatron drops, start an easy mission like Autobot Run off the scoop, and take incidental VUK locks as they present.

Arm Bumblebee 2x at the captive ball, lock three balls at the VUK, and start Transformers Multiball; trigger the Space Bridge add-a-ball to reach 3x, light four jackpots, and cash the Side Ramp super inside that window. Build Combiners off the Side Ramp for their own multiball on the side.

Play two missions to light One Shall Fall at the Right Ramp, a four-ball Optimus-versus-Megatron duel whose payout you pre-load with banked Energon and rusted missions. Clear all five missions instead to light the VUK for Rescue Optimus -- a three-phase wizard that hands you an extra ball and ends in victory laps.
